issues.description: `sys` is referenced in cpython/mathimpl.py and np/math/mathimpl.py without a visible `import sys`, risking NameError at import time.
issues.detail: Both impl files add `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):` guards but the diff shows no corresponding `import sys`. If `sys` is not already imported at module top, the modules will NameError on load for every Python version. Add the import (or confirm it exists) before merge.

issues.description: Conditional registration is dedented outside the class body and rebinds `Math_unary` as a side effect.
issues.detail: The `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11): Math_unary = infer_global(math.exp2)(Math_unary)` block sits with no blank line after the class and reassigns the class name to the decorator return value. Use a bare `infer_global(math.exp2)(Math_unary)` statement placed after the class with proper spacing.

issues.description: Three different version-gate idioms encode the same fact across three files.
issues.detail: Typing and impl files use raw `sys.version_info >= (3, 11)` while the test uses `numba.core.utils.PYVERSION`. The codebase already has PYVERSION as the canonical predicate. Use it everywhere so the version policy lives in one place rather than scattered duplicated branches.

issues.description: Test inputs are copy-pasted from `test_exp` with duplicates, negatives on unsigned types, and no exp2-specific edge cases.
issues.detail: `x_values = [-2, -1, -2, 2, 1, 2, .1, .2]` contains a duplicated `-2`, feeds negatives through uint16/uint32/uint64 relying on wraparound, and never probes values where exp2 differs meaningfully from exp (integer powers of two, 0, inf, nan, large x). Add targeted cases and remove the sloppy duplicates.

issues.description: Release note RST file is missing a trailing newline and underline length is fragile.
issues.detail: `docs/upcoming_changes/10276.new_feature.rst` ends without a final newline and the `------` underline does not match the title length, which RST toolchains may warn or error on. Add the newline and match underline length to the title exactly.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on REFUSE/NEEDS-WORK. Two P0 defects sink the patch: `sys` is used in two impl files without a visible `import sys`, and the conditional registration in mathdecl.py is dedented outside the class body and rebinds `Math_unary` to the decorator return value. Beyond that, three different version-gate idioms encode the same fact across files when the codebase already has `PYVERSION`, the test values are copy-pasted from `test_exp` with duplicates and no exp2-specific edge cases, and the release note RST has formatting hygiene issues. Shape of the feature is correct — small, scoped, gated, tested, documented — but execution needs another pass.
